verdict.rationale: Elicit documents its own automation on new-research events. Alerts send an instant email whenever a new relevant paper is found. A Routine can act on what it finds by filtering on criteria, updating an artifact, or writing a summary, which goes beyond notification. The Routine evidence is a single thin mention, and it is unclear whether Routines fire on events or on a recurring schedule. missing for 10: documented user-defined rule/trigger configuration, explicit event-trigger semantics for Routines (vs. schedule), range of supported events and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A Routine can act on what it finds and hand you a finished analysis: it can filter on criteria an Alert couldn't, update an artifact, or write the summary
Turn on **Instant email alerts** to be immediately alerted whenever a new relevant research paper is found.
